Verify what 10.23.138.197:8081 is and why hostname catalog-svc.internal resolves to it. Separately, follow up on auth-svc S3 PutObject 500/503 errors and status-poller calls to the deprecated legacy-inventory endpoint, which are unrelated to this /search outage.

The config change pointed search-api at a stale or wrong address, which refuses connections. The upstream 503 errors and edge-proxy login failures (auth-svc S3 errors, status-poller legacy-inventory timeouts) are separate, unrelated noise and do not explain the /search outage. Confidence is reduced by the fact that the log never explicitly states what 10.23.138.197 is or why search-api resolves to it.
